patch_description: A symmetry-conscious evolution of the ansatz that adds a center-to-edge hub with three shared parameter families (CRX, CRY, CRZ) in addition to an outer-ring CRX entanglement. This design preserves the data-uploading structure and depth constraints, but increases expressive power and parameter efficiency by reusing a small set of hub parameters across all four edge connections. It aims to improve validation/test performance and reduce overfitting by introducing diverse center-edge interactions (via CRX/CRY/CRZ) while keeping the same inputs/outputs and connectivity constraints.
